stages.data: The supplied subset contains all 58 requested source records. 57 rates reconcile with the supplied figures. West Pokot unknown 8 is official no-data (-9998; zero rural denominator).
stages.qgis: Returned setup report confirms review project creation, preserved original project and no unavailable existing layers. All 58 full polygons and source fields were independently verified.
stages.live_map: Rural road access is integrated as a separate source-polygon view under Travel time / access in all four maps, with a common percentage scale and source-unit selection.

geometry.display_basis: GADM v3.6 source admin2 units from the SEDAC 2023 release
geometry.current_reference_basis: OCHA COD-AB polygons already used by the maps
geometry.policy: Retain source names, fields, record IDs and full polygons. Keep any current administrative outlines clearly identified as reference. Do not transfer rates by name or apportion rural populations by polygon area.
geometry.diagnostic: The overlap review compares current web display geometry, which may be simplified or clipped. Its 95% mutual-overlap threshold is exploratory and is not a compatibility standard or a join rule.

display.band_policy: Lower bounds inclusive; upper bounds exclusive except the final 100% bound.
display.missing: Grey, with a no-computable-value label; preserve valid zero rates where the rural denominator is positive.
selected_source_unit_details: Supplied selection tag, without interpreting it
display.unnamed_units: Retain the source's literal unknown labels and identify their source record IDs.
display.interaction: Render source polygons in the existing layer lifecycle. Clear them when changing views, update desktop/mobile legends, and keep unrelated travel controls out of the rural-access view.

method.definition: 100 times modelled rural population within 2 km of a road classified as likely all-season, divided by modelled rural population in the source unit.
method.roads: OSM downloaded 31 March 2022; all-season condition inferred from tags
method.release: 2023 is the release label, not a single observation year.
method.district_weights: Each district percentage already uses rural population as its denominator.
method.cluster_aggregation: Only after source scope, non-overlap and the supplied selection tags are understood: 100 times sum of valid rural numerators divided by sum of corresponding rural denominators.

junction_wording: The 10 km grid is a chosen starting scale for exploratory comparison; it is not an operational catchment standard. Keep this grid scale distinct from the local-path search distance and junctions per 10 km of road.
